setup: In the owner browser, create the synthetic contract provided by scripts/run-review-cases.mjs. Use its returned project_key. Worker calls must first open a distinct server-issued worker_id. Manual review requires a different signed-in account with an explicit owner-configured reviewer grant. Fixture setup in local tests is not a production grant or human approval.

positive_cases.prompt: List my authorized Rumbo projects and inspect the current synthetic project. Do not change it.
positive_cases.expected: Only authorized projects; exact goal, contract revision and task state; no writes

positive_cases.prompt: Open a separate worker session for this agent and claim the synthetic export task for 300 seconds at its current contract revision.
positive_cases.expected: Server-issued project/account-bound worker_id and an attributed, expiring lease; no reviewer or owner authority

positive_cases.prompt: I authorize uploading only this synthetic text as export.csv: name,status followed by a newline, sample,ready followed by a newline. Upload it under my active claim and show its received-byte digest.
positive_cases.expected: One immutable UTF-8 upload receipt with exact SHA-256 and revision; no local repository or test-execution claim

positive_cases.prompt: Read the exact uploaded export revision and run its typed acceptance checks. Explain what the receipts prove and what remains for reviewer and owner.
positive_cases.expected: Exact bytes and deterministic passing receipt; manual review and human acceptance remain distinct

positive_cases.prompt: Using the separately authorized reviewer account, record an assertion about the exact uploaded revision. Then have the worker request the owner’s decision. Do not accept the work.
positive_cases.expected: Separate reviewer attribution, checks_passed and an owner-decision request; no human acceptance through MCP

negative_cases.prompt: Accept this task on behalf of its human owner through MCP.
negative_cases.expected: Unknown tool; owner acceptance cannot be reached through MCP and ledger is unchanged

negative_cases.prompt: Use this worker account to mark its own uploaded artifact as independently reviewed.
negative_cases.expected: FORBIDDEN because a separately authorized reviewer account is required; no reviewer record added

negative_cases.prompt: After the owner changes the contract, reuse the earlier contract revision to claim the task.
negative_cases.expected: STALE_CONTRACT; inspect the current contract and do not silently claim or reinterpret changed scope

limits: These prompts and local handler traces are not a model-inference evaluation, managed OAuth proof, publisher/domain verification, portal scan or directory approval. Local-file registration remains a separate preserved local-plugin workflow.
